resolved_conflicts.field: move year (Bellevue Hill to Spruce Mountain)
resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Forest Lookouts give 1943; the state forest page gives 1944. The story reports both years and does not choose one.

Register describes a spruce log tower with a wooden cab; a 1931 state report and newspaper quoted by Forest Lookouts describe a glass-enclosed 50-foot tower. The story reports both descriptions; not resolved.
Register lists the tower site at 2,947 ft; the state page gives the Spruce Mountain summit as 3,037 ft. The story gives both figures with their sources.

notes_for_editor: Two open conflicts are reported in the story: the move year (1943 vs 1944) and the 1931 tower design. The brief's height_m 24.0 is not supported by any page read, so it is left out of facts; no source found gives the steel tower's height. Staffing evidence is a 1959 newspaper item and the Register's October 2016 visit form; no current staffing source was found. Access is public per the state page; no closure notice was found. The Register lists the summit site at 2,947 ft while the state page gives 3,037 ft. No photos added. Forest Lookouts page also holds 1938 and 1947-1957 maintenance notes, not used.
